data.one_liner: A 3D rendering engine for Flutter to view, edit, and manipulate 3D models.
data.what_it_does: It is a Dart conversion of Three.js and three_dart, allowing users to render and manipulate 3D objects across multiple platforms. It utilizes ANGLE for desktop and mobile, and WebGL2 for web and WASM applications.
use_when: You need to display and interact with 3D models in a Flutter application.
You want a port of Three.js to use standard 3D rendering pipelines in Dart.
avoid_when: You require an advanced native game engine with a fully integrated physics pipeline out of the box.
You are targeting Linux versions with Flutter < 3.27 or need robust postprocessing on Linux.
strengths: Comprehensive cross-platform support including web, WASM, mobile, and desktop.
Brings the vast ecosystem of Three.js concepts and geometry helpers to Dart.
weaknesses: Several known rendering bugs and unsupported features exist on specific platforms like Linux and Windows.
Requires manual addition of specific JavaScript bindings for web/WASM targets.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific minimum SDK configurations (e.g., minSdk 21 for Android, iOS 13.0+) and adding gles_bindings.js script to index.html for web/WASM targets.

alternatives.name: flutter_scene
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a lightweight 3D scene rendering option optimized natively for Flutter's Impeller renderer.
